note: User-owned configuration for the apply-to-jobs skill. Everything here is specific to ONE person's setup — absolute paths, and the languages their job market's application forms are written in. The skills in the code repo are generic and English-only; this file is what adapts them. Safe to delete: the skills fall back to English-only matching and will ask for the paths they need.

paths.note: Absolute paths to the repo that renders the tailored resume. The apply-to-jobs skill invokes these directly, never via cd. Leave the values null if you do not use a resume-rendering repo.

formVocabulary.note: Phrases, not regexes. Whitespace matches loosely; a trailing * matches any letter suffix, which is what makes inflected languages tractable. These are MERGED on top of the built-in English vocabulary, never replacing it. Add the language(s) your applications are written in.
